title: Consumer Search and Purchase: An Empirical Investigation of Retargeting Based on Consumer Online Behaviors
authors: Zhenling Jiang; Tat Y. Chan; Hai Che; Youwei Wang
eligible_reason: Structural sequential-search model of consumer search and purchase estimated by simulated maximum likelihood; retargeting evaluated by counterfactual simulation. No DiD design.
design_notes: sequential_search.R simulates data and estimates the SeqSearch model (RcppArmadillo C++ likelihood, simulated annealing).
data_files_note: README: data.rda is simulated data that mimic the original data (Monte Carlo); original platform data not shipped.
software_notes: R with a custom Rcpp package (SeqSearch).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally; screened from README, code and abstract. Out of scope.
